"Honored to be performing during the in memoriam segment for the Oscars tonight covering a song I've always loved. Watch with us," Billie shared on her Instagram Stories before the show. It's still unclear what song Billie will be singing, but she did recently record the theme song for Daniel Craig's final James Bond film, No Time to Die, making her the youngest artist in history to write and record a theme song for the franchise.
